text: Chief-assigned typed population errors + smart receipt + exact no-recall-units rename. Scope: population.scala, AlignError cases/rendering in matrix.scala, PopulationSuite only. Planned gate: scalafmtCheckAll, scalafmtSbtCheck, compileAll, align JVM/JS/Native. Tests will assert typed payloads without parsing messages, preserve subject-to-recall binding under permutation/swap, prove private non-case receipt construction has no apply/copy/Product/unapply bypass, check intentional toString, and pin non-empty-text/zero-units naming.
